CLC                             \ C = 0 on both paths
.save_same_page
    LDA s_ptr                       \ ...the screen a character row up (C = 0: &7F + 1)...
    SBC #&7F
    STA s_ptr
    LDA s_ptr + 1
    SBC #&02
    ORA #&40                        \ ...round the 16K: &3D-&3F (below the ring) -> &7D-&7F
    STA s_ptr + 1
    LDY #7                          \ ...from its bottom line: the cell test inline (C = 1, as
    TYA                             \ the ring's high byte is 3 or more)
    SBC rows_m1                     \ line - (rows left - 1)
    BCS last_cell                   \ 0 or more: it ends here
    EOR #&FF                        \ no: rows left after this cell, less 1
    STA rows_m1
    BRA byte                        \ 65C02 opcode (C = 0, as the byte loop needs)
.last_cell                          \ A = line - rows left + 1: the last line drawn
    DEC A                           \ 65C02 opcode: the line below it
    STA stop_y
.part_byte
    LDA (d_ptr),Y
    TAX
    LDA (s_ptr),Y
    STA (v_ptr),Y
mask_operand_2 = * + 1
    AND &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified, as mask_operand
pix_operand_2 = * + 1
    EOR &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified, as pix_operand
    STA (s_ptr),Y
    DEY
    CPY stop_y

    BRA save_same_page              \ 65C02 opcode
.ede5_more                          \ C = 0: the column goes on in the next cell (rare: out of the common path)
    EOR #&FF                        \ rows left after this cell, less 1
    STA rows_m1
    BRA byte                        \ 65C02 opcode (C = 0, as the byte loop needs)
.save_same_page
    LDA s_ptr                       \ ...the screen a character row up (C = 0: &7F + 1)...
    SBC #&7F
    STA s_ptr

    SBC #&02
    ORA #&40                        \ ...round the 16K: &3D-&3F (below the ring) -> &7D-&7F
    STA s_ptr + 1
    LDY #7                          \ ...from its bottom line: the cell test inline (C = 1, as
    TYA                             \ the ring's high byte is 3 or more)
    SBC rows_m1                     \ line - (rows left - 1)
    BCC ede5_more                   \ below 0: not the last cell (the last cell is the common case: falls through)
.last_cell                          \ A = line - rows left + 1: the last line drawn

    STA ede5_stop_imm               \ self-modified: the CPY below's operand (stop_y's zero page byte, no longer read)

    LDA (d_ptr),Y
    TAX
    LDA (s_ptr),Y
    STA (v_ptr),Y
mask_operand_2 = * + 1
    AND &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified, as mask_operand
pix_operand_2 = * + 1
    EOR &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified, as pix_operand
    STA (s_ptr),Y
    DEY
ede5_stop_imm = * + 1
    CPY #0                          \ self-modified: the line below the last one drawn (set at .last_cell)
candidates.summary: Best: both changes in one. (1) part_byte's loop test is CPY #imm, self-modified at .last_cell (2 cycles, not 3, on 31.7 iterations a pass, less the 1-cycle dearer STA abs on 9.4 cells). (2) the inline cell test falls through to .last_cell (6.6 of 7.7 a pass) and branches away (BCC) for the rare more-cells case, whose 3 instructions move above .save_same_page behind a BRA that the page-crossing path pays. It contains the other two candidates, which are alternatives to it.
candidates.equivalence: The part_byte loop's exit compare CPY stop_y (zero page, 3 cycles) becomes CPY #imm (2 cycles) whose operand .last_cell stores (STA abs, 4 cycles, instead of STA zp, 3). stop_y (&C6) is read only by that CPY (grep: src/render.6502 lines 49, 1811, 1823 only; no other file names stop_y) so dropping its write loses nothing, and the compare sees the same value: A after DEC A, stored before the loop is entered (both entries, the inline cell test and 'cell', go through DEC A / STA). The loop body, DEY, flags (Z for BNE, C=1 on exit for next_c) are unchanged. Registers on exit identical (A, X, Y). The operand is written in bank 4 sideways RAM that the code already self-modifies (mask_operand_2, pix_operand_2); the store runs in the same paged state as the loop (it is in the same routine) and no interrupt executes this code. Zero page &C6 (the game's frames/y byte, restored by restore_game_zp only where the logic reads) is now not clobbered by the renderer: not clobbering can only agree with the restore. Reorder: BCS last_cell (taken when 7 >= rows_m1) becomes BCC ede5_more (taken when 7 < rows_m1) and the fall-through is .last_cell: the same A, C (1 into last_cell; 0 into ede5_more, as BCS-not-taken left it), Y=7, flags. ede5_more is the old EOR #&FF / STA rows_m1 / BRA byte, unchanged, entered with C=0 and A=7-rows_m1 as before. The ways into .save_same_page are BCC save_same_page (v_ptr low did not carry; C=0) and the carry path's CLC, which now ends with BRA save_same_page over ede5_more (C=0 kept). The 'cell' test's BCS last_cell elsewhere still reaches .last_cell (label kept, in range). Nothing else names save_same_page or ede5_more (grep).
candidates.relies_on: Self-modifying operand ede5_stop_imm in the draw_column block (bank 4, paged as for mask_operand_2); stop_y read nowhere else (grep -rn stop_y src tools). +1 byte (STA zp -> STA abs; CPY zp -> CPY # same size) slides everything after .last_cell in bank 4 by 1 byte (134 labels, listing diff of the unshifted DEBUG_LIVES bench build): no label changes page; no branch gains a crossing; BEQ gathered (9EFD) stops crossing (a gain); the part_byte loop 9C7B-9C8E stays in one page; ck_* and straight_sprite_* tables shift by 1 so one index of straight_sprite_hi changes crossing (cold). Measured on an assembled scratch build (unshifted DEBUG_LIVES), tools/pcprof.mjs work a pass without the wait: seed 1 (500-2000) 35625.28 -> 35603.12 (-22.2), RIGHT (50-650) 40294.67 -> 40271.92 (-22.8); tools/passlock.mjs control vs test, 1500 passes seed 3 --screen: state and screen identical. Reorder adds a BRA (+2 bytes, +3 in all, 136 labels shift by 3, nothing changes page); measured with the same tools: work a pass seed 1 35625.28 -> 35599.86 (-25.4), RIGHT 40294.67 -> 40267.36 (-27.3); page crossings: the part_byte loop 9C7D-9C90 stays in one page; BEQ no_part (in each_part, cold) newly crosses and BEQ gathered/BEQ in_hazel move, all inside the measured net. passlock seed 1, 1200 passes --screen: state and screen identical. The CLC; BRA costs the page-crossing path (0.5 a pass) 3 cycles.
